seo.description_paragraph: Jivraj is a Sanskrit name that translates to ‘Lord of Life.’ The name is derived from the words ‘jiva’ meaning life and ‘raj’ meaning king. This name is deeply rooted in Hinduism and is believed to signify the protector and ruler of life. In Hindu mythology, Jivraj is often depicted as a deity who grants life and nurtures it until its natural end.
